title: pbs-parity-diff/1
description: Per-case diff.json: every attributed Go-vs-Rust difference of one case after the normalization allowlist (normalization.json) was applied. Every mismatch kind gates parity; CI ratchets the count against parity/baseline.json.

MismatchKind.description: value: semantic JSON value differs. type: JSON type differs. missing_in_rust / extra_in_rust: member or element present on one side only. order: array order differs where no normalization rule applies. lexical: semantically equal JSON with different bytes (class names the difference). status: HTTP status differs. header: header presence or values differ (names compared case-insensitively, value order within a name kept). wire: transport-level difference on the HTTP wire (class names it). stage_missing / stage_extra: a stage is captured on Go only / Rust only (Rust 'unimplemented' maps to stage_missing). error_code / error_text: ErrorRecord code or message differs. metric: a Prometheus (name, labels) delta differs or exists on one side only. timing: categorical timeout outcome differs. decision: a decision point was consulted on one side only or with a different value. unexpected_outbound: an outbound call reached the oracle without any mock.

class.description: Required for lexical (LexicalClass) and wire (WireClass) kinds.

go.description: Go-side value at json_path (null when absent).

rust.description: Rust-side value at json_path (null when absent).

primary.description: True for mismatches at the case's first diverging stage.

consequential_of.description: Signature of the primary mismatch this one follows from.

signature.description: sha1(stage|domain|json_path with indices replaced by [*]|kind), lowercase hex.
